task.title: Create a Strong Password
task.shortdesc: A list of policies to follow in order to create a strong password and an understanding of why a strong password is important.

taskbody.context: Weak passwords contribute to a large percent of cybersecurity breaches. Passwords are the primary gateway institutional systems, email accounts, and sensitive data

step.cmd: Use a mix of upper and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols
Use a different password for every account you have
Only Change your password when there is a suspected breach
